crossRefs.note: Now Yahweh’s Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from Yahweh troubled him.
On the next day, an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David…
and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: An evil spirit from Yahweh was on Saul, as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing with his hand.
translations.bsb: But as Saul was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand, a spirit of distress from the LORD came upon him. While David was playing the harp,
translations.kjv: And the evil spirit from the LORD was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.
translations.asv: And an evil spirit from Jehovah was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing with his hand.
